structure.unit: Uniform Fiduciary Access to Digital Assets Act

law.catch_line: Disclosure of digital assets held in trust when trustee is original user
law.text: Unless otherwise ordered by the court or provided in a trust, a custodian shall disclose to a trustee that is an original user of an account any digital asset of the account held in trust, including a catalog of electronic communications of the trustee and the content of electronic communications.
